description: This file implements a buffered audit backend for Kubernetes, managing event batching, throttling, and asynchronous processing.

classes.name: bufferedBackend
classes.description: A struct implementing an audit backend with buffering, batching, throttling, and optional asynchronous processing.

methods.name: NewBackend
methods.description: Creates a new buffered audit backend with specified delegate and configuration.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the batching process and runs the backend until stop signal.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the backend, ensuring all events are processed.

methods.name: processIncomingEvents
methods.description: Collects events from the buffer channel and batches them for processing.

methods.name: collectEvents
methods.description: Collects a batch of events based on size, timer, or stop signal.

methods.name: processEvents
methods.description: Processes a batch of events, either asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: ProcessEvents
methods.description: Adds events to the buffer queue for processing.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the backend.
